reason_for_amendment: The original top-50 repository frame yielded zero instances before any model call, container build, or Exhibit A verdict: 45 repositories failed pinned-environment eligibility, four eligible repositories had no matching bug PR, and one clone failed. A verdict pilot therefore had no denominator.

changed_selection_rule.repository_frame: Scan in star order and retain the first 50 repositories whose default-branch root dependency input is accepted by the current Docker executor.
changed_selection_rule.if_frame_is_exhausted: Report the shortfall; do not substitute hand-picked repositories.
changed_selection_rule.rationale: This implements the originally intended population—most-starred Python repositories that ship a lock accepted by Exhibit A—without removing any runtime failure or consulting a verdict.

unchanged_selection_rules.pull_request_rule: Merged PRs with an exact case-insensitive bug label, merged from 2026-02-17 through 2026-08-31 inclusive.
unchanged_selection_rules.claim_rule: Use the PR title verbatim. Do not rewrite it or add an expected failure signature.
unchanged_selection_rules.revision_rule: The recorded fix is GitHub's merge_commit_sha and the buggy revision is its first parent.
instance_eligibility: The fixing commit timestamp is inside the registered date window.
At least one production Python file changed; paths under test, tests, testing, docs, documentation, examples, or benchmarks do not count.
Both buggy and fixed revisions have a root pinned dependency input accepted by the current Docker executor.
Both revisions and their relationship resolve through Git without manual repair.
unchanged_selection_rules.candidate_order: Within each repository, merged_at ascending; then round-robin by repository star rank.
unchanged_selection_rules.stopping_rule: Stop at 30 included instances, or report that the mechanically selected universe was exhausted.
unchanged_selection_rules.exclusions: Record every repository-level and PR-level exclusion, including candidates outside the per-repository cap or target sample. No outcome-based exclusion is allowed.

unchanged_model.confirmed_identity_rule: Record backend telemetry when present; otherwise preserve unknown_cli_no_telemetry explicitly.

unchanged_execution.sandbox: Docker executor with network disabled, credentials unavailable, and unprivileged execution
unchanged_execution.outcome_retry_rule: One completed attempt per instance; resume skips completed checkpoints and records interrupted attempts.

unchanged_analysis.headline: VERIFIED divided by all included corpus instances.
unchanged_analysis.partial: Report separately and never merge with VERIFIED.
unchanged_analysis.taxonomy: Use the complete taxonomy and 20% catch-all refinement trigger from pilot-v1 preregistration.
unchanged_analysis.cost: Report provider telemetry; unavailable is not zero.
unchanged_analysis.interpretation: Do not change or filter the corpus after observing outcomes.
